input_dir.description: Directory containing the Intel microcode data files to process.

firmware_dir.description: Destination directory for writing per-processor signature microcode files.

early_fw_file.description: Path to the early initramfs archive file to generate.

verbose_level.description: Verbosity level: 0 for quiet, 1 for normal output, 2+ for verbose.

date_before.description: Select microcodes dated before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty string means no limit.

date_after.description: Select microcodes dated after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty string means no limit.

strict_date_filtering.description: If true, only microcodes entirely within the date range are selected. If false, any revision in range is accepted.

allow_downgrade.description: If true, keep the last loaded microcode version regardless of revision level.

strict_checks.description: If true, perform strict checks on microcode data size and metadata.

ignore_broken.description: If true, skip broken microcode entries instead of aborting.

signatures.description: List of signature filters. Use '!' prefix to deselect. Format: signature, pf_mask, revision_operator_revision. Empty means all selected.
